body: Hi friends @lucasfernog @amrbashir,  could you help me to investigate this bug? Thanks a lot.
Sure thing, I can take a look tomorrow.

Seems like it's a threading issue on the event loop. There's some cases:

- creating two visible windows works
- creating two invisible windows does not work with the tao `dev` branch
- creating one invisible window works if I change `execute_in_thread` to always run `PostMessageW` (seems like it was deadlocking on the ShowWindow call on window_state.rs, maybe because it was executed directly on the event loop thread?)
- creating two invisible windows works if I change `execute_in_thread` to always run `PostMessageW` and comment out the code that sends `Focused` events (it seems like it is stuck sending such events, blocking the event loop).

@amrbashir I think only you can fix this LOL

@lucasfernog  Thank you so much. 

I also found a weird case.

If I change the following code
`WindowUrl::App(PathBuf::from("index.html"))`
to
` WindowUrl::External(url::Url::parse("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BhmXTi0X7Kg").unwrap())`

### The pages are NOT loaded successfully first:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1064052/156907389-4b9de1de-8ec8-439f-80d5-63643e44ea0f.png)

### Now if I click one of the windows, all pages will be loaded at once together:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1064052/156907489-5a0b2e51-2942-4f89-a489-ff3e2c6d086c.png)

### Seems like we will encounter this case if the pages need long time to load.

I found another weird case: it will cause the app to be Not Responding if I click the dock icon multiple times as quickly as possible during the loading process.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1064052/156909160-a41ab5e7-a525-426c-a9fa-b4f0cfea0025.mov

That's a lot of bugs in one issue, I will focus on the first one then see if it solves the other two or if they aren't related.



> Seems like it's a threading issue on the event loop. There's some cases:
> 
> * creating two visible windows works
> * creating two invisible windows does not work with the tao `dev` branch
> * creating one invisible window works if I change `execute_in_thread` to always run `PostMessageW` (seems like it was deadlocking on the ShowWindow call on window_state.rs, maybe because it was executed directly on the event loop thread?)
> * creating two invisible windows works if I change `execute_in_thread` to always run `PostMessageW` and comment out the code that sends `Focused` events (it seems like it is stuck sending such events, blocking the event loop).
> 
> @amrbashir I think only you can fix this LOL

I tracked it to this tao [commit](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao/commit/01fc43b05ea41463d512c0e3497971edc543ac9d) and I don't know how did this go unnoticed for so long but I will look more into it today.

Edit: Since that commit is just porting winit's `new-keyboard` branch, it is worth noting that this bug exists there too.

Edit2: A little progress, it deadlocks in the call to `KeyEventBuilder::process_message` in https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao/blob/11dac10241330c30aae660a2621d43ee5eb3775d/src/platform_impl/windows/event_loop.rs#L906-L911

Edit3: turned out go be a different deadlock

body:
Hopefully fixed in https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao/pull/338. @xuchaoqian If you can, try test it by adding the following in your `Cargo.toml`.
```toml
[patch.crates-io]
tao = { git = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri", branch = "fix/windows/keyboard-deadlock" }
```

Typo alert: it's `tao = { git = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tao", branch = "fix/windows/keyboard-deadlock" }` instead of `tao = { git = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri", branch = "fix/windows/keyboard-deadlock" }`
Also you need to run `cargo run -p tao` on your example.
